methods.ours_stage: our kernel, LRU pool of `capacity` per request, misses staged (PCIe layout)
methods.ours_inplace: our kernel, LRU pool of `capacity` per request, misses read in place, fetch CTAs fill the cache
methods.ours_nocache: our kernel without cache (staged on host tier, in place on peer tier)
methods.hisparse: SGLang HiSparse: load_cache_to_device_buffer_mla (per-request LRU of `capacity` + newest slot, one block per request) then sgl_kernel FlashMLA sparse fwd; MTP rows run one draft token after another, since the HiSparse decode path takes one row per request
methods.floor_fa2: native FA2 MLA with every selected row near: compute floor of our kernel
methods.floor_flashmla: FlashMLA sparse fwd with every selected row in HBM: compute floor of HiSparse
methods.direct_lru: Direct with the same LRU: native attention with hits near and misses read in place, then a GPU gather of the misses into the cache for the next step
methods.memcpy_lru: Memcpy with the same per-request step LRU: copy only each step's missed pages near (host: untimed CPU gather + H2D DMA; peer: GPU gather), then native attention
